newsitem.title: USA: Rexall Sundown shrs slump on merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Rexall Sundown shrs slump on merger talks.

text.p: Rexall Sundown Inc shares fell 10 percent in unusually heavy Nasdaq trade Tuesday after the nutritional supplement and vitamin company announced it is in talks to buy TwinLab Corp, traders said.
In midafternoon trade, Rexall shares were off four to 35, a 10.3 percent decline, with almost 700,000 shares traded, exceeding the average daily volume of about 540,000 shares.
Meanwhile, TwinLab shares were up 3/8 to 24-3/8, falling from an earlier peak, and new year-high, of 27-1/8 reached earlier in the session.
Before Tuesday's U.S. market open, the companies said they are engaged in "substantial" merger talks that would combine the two companies.
They said the merger would be effected through an exchange of stock at a ratio of 0.74 Rexall common shares for each Twinlab common share.
There can be no assurances a definitive agreement will be reached, they said in the prepared statement.
Spokesmen for the companies did not immediately respond to requests for additional details about the talks or a possible transaction.
TwinLabs, based in Ronkonkoma, NY, also makes vitamins and nutritional supplements.
The company has 27 million shares outstanding, almost 64 percent held by the company's directors and officers, according to U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission documents.
TwinLab went public in November 1996 with an 8.5 million share offering at $12 per share.
The company reported net sales of $170.1 million in 1996 and pro forma net income of $0.08 per share versus net sales of $148.7 million and pro forma net income per share of $0.68.
